description: The underlying case data itself contains two records that disagree (e.g. a cross-source merge conflict on a transaction's amount/timestamp -- see CanonicalCaseMerger). A claim that asserts one side of the conflict as settled fact, when the case's own provenance shows it is disputed, should be judged 'contradicted', not 'supported'.

claims.text: The exit transfer T2-001 was settled on 2026-02-02, confirming same-day exfiltration.
claims.note: case_manifest.json records a genuine cross-source merge conflict on T2-001's timestamp (2026-02-02 vs 2026-02-05) -- asserting one value as settled fact, without acknowledging the conflict, contradicts the case's own recorded provenance.
